# order_by_direction

<!-- Generated by xtask. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Summary:** Requires consistent ASC/DESC modifiers across ORDER BY items.

**Category:** `convention`

**Editor default:** `hidden`

**Default level:** `hint`

**Fixable:** yes

## Rationale

When some ORDER BY items include a direction and others do not, intent is harder to read.

## Configuration

```toml
[lints]
order_by_direction = { level = "warn" }
```

### Options

No options.

## Examples

**Anti-pattern:**

```sql
SELECT a, b FROM foo ORDER BY a, b DESC
```

**Best practice:**

```sql
SELECT a, b FROM foo ORDER BY a ASC, b DESC
```
